program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
                  (rects (filter (lambda (o)
                                   (let* ((bb (obj-bbox o))
                                          (bh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
                                          (bw (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
                                     (> (* bh bw) 2)))
                                 objs))
                  (rect-list (map (lambda (o)
                                    (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                      (list (obj-color o)
                                            (first bb)
                                            (second bb)
                                            (third bb)
                                            (fourth bb))))
                                  rects))
                  (row-breaks (remove-duplicates (sort (apply append
                                                              (map (lambda (r)
                                                                     (list (second r)
                                                                           (+ 1
                                                                              (fourth r))))
                                                                   rect-list))
                                                       <)))
                  (col-breaks (remove-duplicates (sort (apply append
                                                              (map (lambda (r)
                                                                     (list (third r)
                                                                           (+ 1
                                                                              (fifth r))))
                                                                   rect-list))
                                                       <)))
                  (row-groups (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length row-breaks) 1))))
                                (list (list-ref row-breaks i)
                                      (- (list-ref row-breaks (+ i 1)) 1))))
                  (col-slots (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length col-breaks) 1))))
                               (list (list-ref col-breaks i)
                                     (- (list-ref col-breaks (+ i 1)) 1))))
                  (num-rows (length row-groups))
                  (num-cols (length col-slots))
                  (find-color (lambda (rg-r1 rg-r2 cs-c1 cs-c2)
                                (let loop
                                     ((rs rect-list))
                                     (cond
                                       ((null? rs) 0)
                                       (else (let* ((r (car rs))
                                                    (r1 (second r))
                                                    (c1 (third r))
                                                    (r2 (fourth r))
                                                    (c2 (fifth r)))
                                               (if (and
                                                     (<= r1 rg-r1)
                                                     (>= r2 rg-r2)
                                                     (<= c1 cs-c1)
                                                     (>= c2 cs-c2))
                                                   (first r)
                                                   (loop (cdr rs))))))))))
             (build-grid num-rows
                         num-cols
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((slot-idx (- num-cols 1 c))
                                (rg (list-ref row-groups r))
                                (cs (list-ref col-slots slot-idx)))
                           (find-color (first rg) (second rg) (first cs) (second cs))))))))
